groups.R_reason: Excess death figures are retrospectively calculated and subject to heavy statistical revisions over months or years, making them poor for prediction markets.
groups.S_reason: European national health agencies (e.g., INSEE in France) eventually release excess mortality reports.
groups.T_reason: Usually requires waiting quarters or years for peer-reviewed demographic statistical consensus.
groups.U_reason: Vague boundaries of what constitutes 'heatwave-linked' death.
groups.H_reason: General global warming awareness exists, but European-specific excess death stats do not capture PH local betting attention.
